# dataSets

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

## Description

Data sets used in the examples and tests of other projects in R (R Core
Team, 2026).

## Installation

You can install the development version of `dataSets` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/dataSets) with:

\
`if`` ``(``!`[`require`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`"pak"`](https://pak.r-lib.org/)`)``)`` `[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"pak"``)`\
`pak``::`[`pkg_install`](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/pkg_install.html)`(``"ijapesigan/dataSets"``)`

## Data Sets

| Name      | Source                           |
|-----------|----------------------------------|
| `nas1982` | National Research Council (1982) |
